subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class durable subagent lifecycle/supervision contract, and should it extend task/audit RPCs or introduce a new subagent receipt surface?
rationale: The remaining work defines a public, persistent, security-sensitive operator API rather than a narrow bug fix, so automation cannot choose the long-term protocol boundary safely.

options.title: Extend Task And Audit Primitives
options.body: Model lifecycle receipts as metadata-only task/audit/artifact records and expose only bounded public RPC fields.

options.title: Limit To Timeline UX
options.body: Keep supervision actions private and track only an operator timeline view under the existing task summary surface.

options.title: Defer The Contract
options.body: Leave current task/audit/artifact summaries as the supported surface and close or narrow this issue to a future design document.

recommendation.title: Extend Task And Audit Primitives
recommendation.body: Model lifecycle receipts as metadata-only task/audit/artifact records and expose only bounded public RPC fields.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this owner to adjacent task UI, audit, and history surfaces where the public contract decision would land.
